purpose: Check 365aa84's rule (installed packages in the project's dependency graph stay as unpinned requests) on its counterexample and two neighbours.
how: probes/test_orphans.py with each checkout's offline_resolver fixture (local wheels/sdists, real uv, --no-index).

test_codex_counterexample.setup: 365aa84's own counterexample: base1 -> obsolete1 -> helper<2, base2 -> helper>=2, helper 1.0 installed. An in-place install would leave obsolete1 and fail pip check. Expected: not_resolved.

365aa84.error: install declared set did not complete successfully; see the recorded output

test_harmless_orphan_with_wheel.setup: base1 -> obsolete1 (no requirements; wheels 1.0 and 2.0), base2 -> helper>=2 (not installed). An in-place install stays consistent. Expected: resolved.

test_harmless_orphan_sdist_only.setup: Same harmless orphan, but obsolete1 exists only as an sdist (as for packages that never shipped wheels). An in-place install stays consistent. Expected: resolved.

365aa84.error: The wheel-only trial cannot install ff-trial-obsolete==1.0
